overview: Metronome’s documentation home introduces a quickstart path aimed at getting users to their first invoice. It organizes pricing and packaging guidance around pay-as-you-go billing, enterprise commits, subscriptions with usage, and pre-paid credits. The page also provides a “Get started with” section covering contracts, invoicing, and rev-rec.
key_takeaways: The Quickstart guide is presented as a path to a first invoice on Metronome.
Pay-as-you-go billing is described as charging customers in arrears for only what they use.
Enterprise commits cover prepaid and postpaid commitments, negotiated discounts, one-time charges, and contract renewals.
Pre-paid credits can be purchased upfront and can use auto-recharge or gated access when credits run out.

details.heading: Pricing and packaging
facts: The page groups pricing and packaging guidance into pay-as-you-go billing, enterprise commits, subscriptions with usage, and pre-paid credits.
Subscriptions with usage are described as combining recurring revenue with usage-based components.

details.heading: Getting-started destinations
facts: The page links users to Contracts, Invoicing, and Rev-rec under “Get started with”.
